'''Barnett''': {{legend0|#ffb2b2|40–50%}} {{legend0|#e27f7f|50–60%}} {{legend0|#d75d5d|60–70%}} | title = Governor | before_election = [[Kathleen Sebelius]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Kathleen Sebelius]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsKS}} The '''2006 Kansas gubernatorial election''' took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democratic Governor [[Kathleen Sebelius]], who sported high approval ratings{{Cite web| title=Approval Ratings For All 50 Governors| url=http://www.surveyusa.com/50State2006/50StateGovernor060720State.htm| publisher=SurveyUSA/KWCH-TV/KCTV-TV| date=2006-07-20| access-date=2007-11-28}} ran for re-election to serve a second and final term. She was unopposed for the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] nomination and faced [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Kansas State Senate|State Senator]] [[Jim Barnett (Kansas politician)|Jim Barnett]], who emerged from a crowded primary. Sebelius defeated Barnett and was re-elected with more than 57% of the vote.
